Meet Sennelo

I'm Sennelo Mulanga Gundo, a junior software engineer in Johannesburg focused on backend development and full-stack delivery.

I hold a BSc in Information Technology from the University of Johannesburg. At TheRad, I developed Laravel / Filament ERP modules, worked with relational data and shipped a maths learning platform. My projects extend that foundation with .NET APIs, background processing and React / TypeScript interfaces. I enjoy building software that solves real-world problems.

Experience

Developed and maintained Laravel / Filament modules for a manufacturing ERP, implementing business logic, workflows and admin functionality. Worked with relational data models and queries to maintain integrity across modules. Independently designed, built and deployed a platform of 26 maths games with JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Diagnosed and resolved defects on a client-facing Joomla / PHP website, alongside implementation, testing and deployment in a remote engineering team.

Education

Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, completed at the University of Johannesburg in Auckland Park, Johannesburg. My work applies that foundation to backend development, relational data, full-stack applications and practical problem-solving.
